title: PowerX
description: minimalist tech pack with quality of life, performance, and shaders
body:
<details>
<summary>Content</summary>

**Applied Energistics:** Adds the ME system and other computers for storage and other automation needs

**Artifacts:** Adds some unique items found only in structures the mod adds

**Chococraft:** Adds chocobos a mob with several variety useful for early game transportation

**Decocraft:** Adds tons of decoration and furniture blocks

**Draconic Evolution:** End game machinery, bosses and equipment

**Industrial Foregoing:** Adds more useful machines for automation

**Mekanism:** Great tech/power mod 

**Mekanism Generators**: Adds many new great generators for power for early and late game

**Mystical Agriculture:** Adds a way to farm valuable materials through aggriculture

**Silent Gear:** Customizable and upgradable tools/weapons/armor
</details>
<details>
<summary>Quality of Life</summary>

**Chicken Chunks:** Adds a block that allows you to keep chunks loaded for your base/farms/etc

**ElevatorMod:** Adds a simple elevator block making it easier to make a seamless multi-floor 
base

**Enchanting Infuser:** Allows you to pick the enchantments you want 

**EnderTanks:** Allows you to move fluids wirelessly

**Heart Crystals:** Adds heart crystals you can find in the world to give yourself more health

**Mob Lassos:** Adds a lasso giving you the ability to transport mobs efficiently

**Portable Spawners:** Allows you to move spawners with Silk Touch 

**Sophisticated Backpacks:** The best and most unique backpack mod
</details>
<details>
<summary>Performance & Game</summary>

**Battle Towers:** Adds towers in the overworld and nether with several floors of enemies and loot

**Biomes O' Plenty:** Adds lots of new biomes to brighten up your world

**Controlling:** Adds the ability to search keybinds

**CoreCommands:** Adds commands for /warp /home and /tp

**Cubes Without Borders:** Makes fullscreen mode borderless (makes tabbing into a different window easier)

**Draconic Evolution Render Patcher:** Fixes render issues between DE and Embeddium

**FerriteCore:** Performance mod affecting memory usage

**GravestoneMod:** When you die all of your items will be safe inside a gravestone

**Jade:** Allows you to see what items/blocks are from which mod

**JEI:** Allows you to see different crafting recipes across mods

**KubeJS:** Allows developers to balance the modpack

**Neat:** Adds health bars for mobs

**Searchables:** Makes it easier to search through different mods

**Sodium**: General performance mod

**Sodium Extra:** Addon for Sodium

**Veinminer++:** Mine a group of blocks at once
</details>


<details>
<summary>Buffs & Nerfs</summary>
  
Removed Mekka Armor (Mekanism)
  
Removed Mekka Tool (Mekanism)

Removed Jetpacks (Mekanism)

Removed Flamethrower (Mekanism)

Removed Atomic Disassembler (Mekanism)

Removed Electric Bow (Mekanism)

Removed Free Runners (Mekanism)

Removed All Units For The Items Above (Mekanism)

Removed All Infinity Items (Industrial Foregoing)

Removed Tinker Table (Mystical Agriculture)

Removed All Armor/Tools/Weapons (Mystical Agriculture)

Removed All Augments for (Mystical Agriculuture) Items

Buffed (Artifacts) Spawn Rate

Buffed Wither Skeleton Head Drop Chance With Looting Enchant LI -> 11% LII -> 22% LIII -> 33%

Buffed (Heart Crytals) Half Heart -> Full Heart

Nerfed (Heart Crystals) Max HP 80 -> 40

</details>
